projects.name: Houston products factory facility expansion
projects.quote: We have planned capital spending of approximately $11 million on a facility expansion project at our products factory in Houston.

projects.name: Houston, Texas land and buildings purchase
projects.quote: In July 2024, we made a cash purchase of land and buildings in Houston, Texas for $5.6 million to help further facilitate executing the current backlog as well as planning for modest future volume growth.
